highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
highlights_body: This major release consolidates over a year of v4 preview work: variable font support, animated WebP encoding, color font palettes, and a deterministic singleton lifecycle. It is a breaking release — review the changes below before upgrading from 3.x.

breaking.title: SKPaint text/font members removed
breaking.body: Font-related members on SKPaint (Typeface, TextSize, TextScaleX, and related text-state APIs) obsoleted in v3 are now compile errors. Move typeface and text sizing onto SKFont.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now carries an empty typeface
breaking.body: Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty, so MeasureText and Draw produce nothing. Pass an explicit typeface: new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default). Detect 'no typeface' with font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of == null.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface returns Default instead of null
breaking.body: SKPaint.Typeface is SKTypeface.Default on creation, not null. Text drawing still works; code testing paint.Typeface == null to detect 'unset' must switch to paint.Typeface.IsEmpty.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns Default on all platforms when the family is missing
breaking.body: Android previously returned null for an unknown family. All platforms now return SKTypeface.Default. For strict null semantics use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(), which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) throws OverflowException and is obsolete
breaking.body: The native offset is 32-bit. Values outside int range now throw OverflowException instead of silently truncating. Call Move(int) and clamp or validate large offsets before the call.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instances
breaking.body: Ganesh requires Vulkan 1.1. On a Vulkan 1.0 instance the native layer calls SK_ABORT — not a managed exception, so it cannot be caught. Set both VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to VK_API_VERSION_1_1. Leaving MaxAPIVersion at 0 is unsafe.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative: five fields removed
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are gone upstream. Replace fExtensions with fVkExtensions and fFeatures with fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2; delete the remaining three with no replacement.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo type changed; GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value equality
breaking.body: The property type changed from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, and the old type no longer implements IEquatable. Update variable declarations and remove == comparisons on the old type.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed
breaking.body: The protected setter was an implementation detail never intended for subclasses. Subclasses that assigned this property must be updated; the getter remains readable.

bullets.lead: Skia updated through milestone m148
bullets.detail: Rolls up m132, m133, m147, and m148 plus stability patches from each, bringing upstream rendering fixes, improved text shaping, and groundwork for the new GPU pipeline.

bullets.lead: Variable font support
bullets.detail: Full variable font axis enumeration and value control via SKFont and HarfBuzzSharp, including font-family matching by variation axes and robust handling of edge-case axis values.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding
bullets.detail: SKWebpEncoder now supports writing animated WebP sequences, enabling frame-by-frame animated image output at configurable quality and timing.

bullets.lead: Color font palette support
bullets.detail: Color fonts (COLR/CPAL) can now have their palette selected and customized via SKFont, enabling rich emoji and decorative glyph rendering.

bullets.lead: SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data access
bullets.detail: New SKStream.GetData() returns the underlying SKData without copying, useful for efficient stream-to-memory transfers where a copy would be wasteful.

bullets.lead: SKSamplingOptions on SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface
bullets.detail: Pass explicit sampling filters when compositing surfaces, giving finer control over image quality vs. performance trade-offs.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzzSharp: HBColor struct and new API wrappers
bullets.detail: Added the HBColor struct for proper hb_color_t representation, filled in missing API wrappers, and corrected naming-convention violations across the HarfBuzz bindings.

bullets.lead: Native-compat gate moved to SkiaApi static constructor
bullets.detail: The native-library version-mismatch check that previously ran in a [ModuleInitializer] now runs in the SkiaApi static constructor, making the failure deterministic and easier to diagnose at startup.

bullets.lead: SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and axis corrected
bullets.detail: GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes (not Width×bytesPerPixel) for stride, and the x,y overload used Height instead of Width to compute the offset — both producing wrong pixel addresses on non-tight bitmaps.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer crash fixed
bullets.detail: When SKPath and its parent SKPathBuilder were GC-collected in reverse order the finalizer crashed. The correct keep-alive pattern is now used.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution fixed on Android API 36+
bullets.detail: SKTypeface.Default now resolves through the font manager with an empty-typeface fallback, preventing process termination on Android API 36+ where the old native path returned null.

bullets.lead: WinUI: Projection DLL not found on .NET 9 fixed
bullets.detail: WinUI consumers on .NET 9 saw a DLL-load failure at startup. The correct projection assembly is now resolved for all target frameworks.

bullets.lead: SKGLView restores rendering after tab switch in MAUI
bullets.detail: On MAUI TabBar, SKGLView stopped rendering after switching away and back. The GL context lifecycle is now correctly restored on re-attach.

bullets.lead: Singleton lifecycle reworked for deterministic disposal
bullets.detail: The internal singleton pattern used by native handles is redesigned so that disposal ordering is deterministic, preventing use-after-free crashes in long-running applications.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic native assets added
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp now ships native libraries built against the Bionic libc, enabling use in environments without a standard glibc — notably older Android-NDK-based runtimes.

bullets.lead: Tizen x64 and arm64 native builds
bullets.detail: Two new Tizen target architectures are now built and shipped, expanding .NET on Tizen platform coverage.

bullets.lead: Apple TFMs corrected: versioned for libraries, unversioned for apps
bullets.detail: Apple TFMs now use versioned monikers (ios16.0, maccatalyst14.0, …) for library packages and unversioned ones for app projects, aligning with .NET conventions.

bullets.lead: WASM: pre-.NET 8 Emscripten builds dropped
bullets.detail: Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions below the .NET 8 minimum are no longer produced, reducing artifact size and build time.

bullets.lead: C# 13 language support on legacy TFMs via PolySharp
bullets.detail: PolySharp is added as a build dependency to polyfill C# 13 language features on .NET Standard and older TFMs.

bullets.lead: Native dependency refresh
bullets.detail: libpng → 1.6.58, libexpat → 2.7.5 and 2.8.1, freetype → 2.14.3, zlib → 1.3.2.1-motley, libjpeg-turbo → 3.1.4.1, and HarfBuzz → 14.2.0.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Singleton lifecycle rework, SKPath finalizer fix, variable font support and robustness, SkiaFiddle UX improvements, Uno Platform sample work, and SkiaSharpGenerator Linux fix
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and PolySharp C# 13 polyfill support
contributor_summaries.ebariche: SkiaFiddle WASM bundle size reduction of roughly 60%
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Updated Uno Platform description and link in README
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after tab switch in MAUI TabBar

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Release candidate fixing GetPixelSpan stride and offset bugs, promoting pre-v4 obsoletes to compile errors, moving the native-compat gate to the SkiaApi static constructor, and applying m147 upstream stability patches.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Added HBColor struct and missing HarfBuzz API wrappers, updated libjpeg-turbo, dropped legacy WASM builds, and stood up automated API diff generation.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Delivered animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData(), SKPath finalizer fix, Apple TFM corrections, and the first documentation and tooling infrastructure for v4.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Opened the v4 line with Skia m132/m133/m147 engine bumps, variable font support, color font palettes, SKSamplingOptions on surfaces, Linux Bionic assets, Tizen builds, and the full lifecycle rework.

harfbuzz_summary: Updated to HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0, adding the HBColor struct for proper hb_color_t representation and filling in missing API wrappers with corrected naming conventions.
